# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #301 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

> Run from the worktree root with the worktree's own build (`node "$PWD/bin/codeloop.js"`). Sandboxes live under the tool's sanctioned root `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/` because `FileStateRepository` refuses foreign `/tmp` state. Each block is self-contained.
>
> **Expected on `1f85ef7` (before the fix):** S1/S2 report `NO` and `PRESENT`; S3/S4 exit 0 or leave worktrees; S5 refuses `--dry-run`; S6 creates `900.json`; S7 lists `.agyloop`/`artifacts`; S8 fails with "nothing added to commit". **After the fix every block prints the `PASS` line shown.**

**S1 — a bare run at PLAN is a pure read (AC-1, AC-2).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-plan"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 777
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition PLAN --issue 777
BEFORE=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/777.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" --issue 777; echo "exit=$?"
AFTER=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/777.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo "PASS checkpoint byte-identical" || echo "FAIL checkpoint changed"
[ -d .worktrees/777 ] && echo "FAIL worktree provisioned" || echo "PASS no worktree"
git worktree list
```

**S2 — a bare run that parks at DISCOVERY writes nothing (AC-1, AC-6).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-park"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 778
rm -rf artifacts .gitignore
BEFORE=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/778.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" --issue 778; echo "exit=$?"
AFTER=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/778.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo "PASS checkpoint byte-identical" || echo "FAIL checkpoint changed"
[ -d artifacts ] && { echo "FAIL artifacts written:"; find artifacts -type f; } || echo "PASS no plan artifacts"
[ -f .gitignore ] && echo "FAIL .gitignore written" || echo "PASS no .gitignore"
```

**S3 — a refused transition save writes no artifacts and exits 1 (AC-7).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-refused"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks && chmod 555 .agyloop/tasks
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 906; echo "exit=$?"
[ -d artifacts ] && { echo "FAIL artifacts written:"; find artifacts -type f; } || echo "PASS no plan artifacts"
chmod 755 .agyloop/tasks
```

**S4 — a failed descriptor save is loud, tears the worktree down, and never falls back to root (AC-3, AC-4).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-descriptor"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 904
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition PLAN --issue 904
printf '## Implementation\n\n- [ ] step 1\n' > artifacts/plans/904-task-plan/implementation_plan.md
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition APPROVAL --issue 904
chmod 444 .agyloop/tasks/904.json
BEFORE=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/904.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" --issue 904; echo "exit=$?"
AFTER=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/904.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
chmod 644 .agyloop/tasks/904.json
[ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo "PASS checkpoint untouched" || echo "FAIL checkpoint rewritten"
[ -d .worktrees/904 ] && echo "FAIL orphan worktree left behind" || echo "PASS worktree torn down"
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 904 --json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const p=JSON.parse(s);console.log(p.worktreePath===null?"PASS next reports worktreePath=null":"FAIL next reports "+p.worktreePath)})'
git worktree list
```

**S5 — `next --dry-run` is honoured and the help text is truthful (AC-5).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-dryrun"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 905
BEFORE=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/905.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 905 --dry-run --json > next.json; echo "exit=$?"
AFTER=$(sha256sum .agyloop/tasks/905.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo "PASS dry-run wrote nothing" || echo "FAIL dry-run rewrote the checkpoint"
node -e 'const p=require(process.cwd()+"/next.json");console.log("dryRun:",p.dryRun);console.log("wouldWrite:",JSON.stringify(p.wouldWrite));process.exit(p.dryRun===true&&Array.isArray(p.wouldWrite)&&p.wouldWrite.length>0?0:1)' && echo "PASS dry-run declares its writes"
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" --help | grep -E "^  next" 
```

**S6 — `next` on an absent checkpoint creates no task file; a real read writes only its declared set (AC-5).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-absent"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 900 --json > absent.json; echo "exit=$?"
[ -f .agyloop/tasks/900.json ] && echo "FAIL next created a task file" || echo "PASS no task file created"
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 905
cp .agyloop/tasks/905.json before.json
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 905 --json > read.json
node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("before.json"));const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/905.json"));const keys=[...new Set([...Object.keys(a),...Object.keys(b)])];const changed=keys.filter(k=>JSON.stringify(a[k])!==JSON.stringify(b[k])).sort();console.log("changed:",changed.join(","));const allowed=["baseBranch","discoveryDispatchCount","updatedAt"];process.exit(changed.every(k=>allowed.includes(k))?0:1)' && echo "PASS only declared context fields changed"
```

**S7 — root-scoped COMMIT succeeds and the printed list equals the committed paths (AC-8, AC-9, AC-10).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-commit"
OUT="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-commit.out"
rm -rf "$SB" "$SB.origin.git"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
git init -q --bare "$SB.origin.git" && git remote add origin "$SB.origin.git"
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks
node -e 'require("fs").writeFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/908.json",JSON.stringify({version:"1.0.0",currentStage:"COMMIT",mode:"standard",issue:908,baseBranch:"main",planDir:null,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),history:[{stage:"COMMIT",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}],worktree:null,pausedAtGate:"COMMIT",pausedAtTimestamp:new Date().toISOString(),totalHumanWaitMs:0},null,2))'
printf 'feature\n' > feature.txt
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 908 -y --keep-worktree > "$OUT" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
cat "$OUT"
grep -q "Committed in: .*(workspace root)" "$OUT" && echo "PASS reported root cwd" || echo "FAIL cwd not reported as root"
grep -q "Files to commit (1)" "$OUT" && echo "PASS draft listed exactly the real change" || echo "FAIL draft count disagrees with the tree"
test "$(git show --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD | sed '/^$/d')" = "feature.txt" && echo "PASS committed exactly feature.txt" || echo "FAIL committed paths disagree with the draft"
node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/908.json","utf8"));process.exit(s.currentStage==="COMPLETED"?0:1)' && echo "PASS pipeline COMPLETED"
```

**S8 — a tree containing only bookkeeping paths fails honestly (AC-9).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-nothing"
OUT="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-nothing.out"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks artifacts/plans/909-task-plan
node -e 'require("fs").writeFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/909.json",JSON.stringify({version:"1.0.0",currentStage:"COMMIT",mode:"standard",issue:909,baseBranch:"main",createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),history:[{stage:"COMMIT",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}],worktree:null,pausedAtGate:"COMMIT",pausedAtTimestamp:new Date().toISOString(),totalHumanWaitMs:0},null,2))'
printf 'note\n' > artifacts/plans/909-task-plan/note.md
BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 909 -y --keep-worktree > "$OUT" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
cat "$OUT"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BEFORE" && echo "PASS HEAD unchanged" || echo "FAIL HEAD moved"
grep -qE "Nothing to commit:.*excludes|only paths agyloop excludes" "$OUT" && echo "PASS honest refusal" || echo "FAIL unhelpful message"
```

**S9 — the control: an isolated run still commits inside its worktree (AC-8).**

```bash
REPO="$PWD"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-301-isolated"
rm -rf "$SB" "$SB.origin.git"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cd "$SB"
git init -q -b main . && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name a
printf 'base\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm base
git init -q --bare "$SB.origin.git" && git remote add origin "$SB.origin.git"
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY --issue 910
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition PLAN --issue 910
printf '## Implementation\n\n- [ ] step 1\n' > artifacts/plans/910-task-plan/implementation_plan.md
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition APPROVAL --issue 910
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition IMPLEMENT --issue 910
git worktree list
[ -d .worktrees/910 ] && echo "PASS worktree provisioned once (transition)" || echo "FAIL no worktree"
printf 'impl\n' > .worktrees/910/feature.txt
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition QUALITY_GATE --issue 910
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 910
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition COMMIT --issue 910
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 910 -y --keep-worktree > isolated.out 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
grep -q "Committed in: .*\.worktrees/910.*isolated worktree" isolated.out && echo "PASS committed inside the worktree" || { echo "FAIL cwd not the worktree"; cat isolated.out; }
```
